test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the sentence that has the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bad blood

options.text: She is so scared of cockroaches that she fainted when she saw them crawling near her foot.
The doctor dropped the bad news to Ravi as he was suffering from a serious disease.
The gangster had some bitter relations with a local activist so he warned him to stay out of his business.
Sushant always gets in trouble for telling lies but he never learns anything.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The gangster had some bitter relations with a local activist so he warned him to stay out of his business.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Bad blood" means a hostile or negative relationship between two people or groups.**
